g.text: A side-view example of forward acceleration, cruising, and braking
Shaded cone + colored arrow: camera view • Orange arrow: thrust direction
Near level if drag is small
Both methods can produce this tilt sequence.
Custom: approximate rate response. Rigid body: torque + inertia determine the response and any tracking error.
Illustration only: angles, spacing and viewing cones are schematic; these are not simulation results or rendered 3DGS RGB.
Camera optical axis assumed along body +X here. The real mounting rotation changes the absolute viewing direction; drag can require tilt during cruise.
